name: Atorvastatin
summary: A high-value statin used for LDL lowering and cardiovascular risk reduction across primary and secondary prevention settings.
good: Patients needing meaningful LDL lowering and CV risk reduction.
bad: Unexplained muscle symptoms or strong interaction burden without review.
clinicalPearls: The dose-intensity strategy matters more than the brand name.
mechanism: Inhibits HMG-CoA reductase, lowering hepatic cholesterol synthesis and increasing LDL receptor expression.
indications: Hyperlipidemia, atherosclerotic risk reduction, post-ACS care, and diabetes-associated CV prevention.
interactionNotes: CYP3A4 inhibitors, grapefruit-heavy intake in susceptible patients, and combination with fibrates raise caution.

warnings: Myalgia, rare myopathy/rhabdomyolysis, and liver enzyme elevation are the major safety themes.
